memo: First GPU submission of the class-3 generator (pushed now in case the weekly GPU quota is back; a quota rejection uses no slot). Base: public 0.420 notebook (huseyinemreaksoy casmi26-v4n-fusion, Apache-2.0, and what it credits). Ours: MMP generator mined from train (up to 100 products), two-step MMP (20 intermediates from the top 3 spectral analogs), 10 FP-retrieved parents. Class-3 val (base lists): MRR@25 0.103 -> 0.2325, hit@TOPN 0.406; in-pool harm none (e2keep-1). The CPU versions (0.378/0.381) lacked ICEBERG; this one keeps ICEBERG/GLACIER on the GPU as the base does. Hypothesis: LB > 0.420.
message: e2gpu-1: base 0.420 + our MMP class-3 generator (100, two-step 20, 10 FP parents) on GPU
